title: Filter Rows by Date Range
learning_objective: Learn how to keep rows inside a reporting date window.

tutorial.explanation: Date problems usually start by limiting the timeline to the requested range. Store dates as real DATE values when possible; here we cast text dates for practice.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT fail_date FROM failed WHERE CAST(fail_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31';
tutorial.mental_model: Filtering dates first gives every later step a clean timeline to work with.

guided_example.solution_query: SELECT fail_date FROM failed WHERE CAST(fail_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31';
guided_example.explanation: BETWEEN keeps dates from the start through the end date.

practice.prompt: Return fail_date values from January 1 to January 2, 2026.
practice.expected_query: SELECT fail_date FROM failed WHERE CAST(fail_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-02';

hints: Use DATE literals for the boundaries.
